content.title: Where to watch Alabama vs Michigan today: Sweet 16 start time, TV info
content.text: Updated March 27, 2026, 10:18 p.m. ETThe Alabama Crimson Tide are in the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament for the fourth straight year. For the second time in three years, Nate Oats' team will face a No. 1 regional seed in the Sweet 16. The Crimson Tide take on the Big Ten regular-season champion Michigan Wolverines at United Center in Chicago.Alabama (25-9), the No. 4 seed in the Midwest Region, started hot in a dominant second-round victory over No. 5 seed Texas Tech on Sunday in Tampa. The Crimson Tide outworked the Red Raiders on the glass with a 31-16 edge in rebounding early and led by 26 points before halftime in a 90-65 rout. Alabama sank 19 3-pointers. Latrell Wrightsell led the way with 24 points and Houston Mallette added 15. Amari Allen (12 points) and Aiden Sherrell (10) also finished in double figures. Leading scorer Labaron Philon had a career-high 12 assists.Michigan (33-3) cruised past both 16th-seeded Howard and ninth-seeded Saint Louis to reach the Sweet 16 for the second straight year under coach Dusty May. Wolverines star Yaxel Lendeborg had 25 points and six rebounds in his team's 95-72 victory over Saint Louis. The 6-foot-9 big man is averaging 14.7 points and seven rebounds a night. Alabama and Michigan are meeting for only the fourth time in men's basketball history. The Crimson Tide lead the brief series, 2-1.Stream Alabama vs. MichiganWhat channel is Alabama vs. Michigan on today?TV Channel: TBS, truTVLivestream: Watch on Sling (regional restrictions may apply)Alabama-Michigan will be televised nationally on TBS and truTV at the 2026 NCAA Tournament. Andrew Catalon and Steve Lappas will call the game from United Center, with Evan Washburn reporting from the sidelines.
